pwa.installDescription: Install ezPrint for quick access in its own app window.
pwa.updateDescription: A new ezPrint version is ready. Reload to use it.
pwa.offlineDescription: Data cannot be loaded or saved without a connection to the ezPrint server.
pwa.offlinePageDescription: Restore the connection to the ezPrint server to sign in and work with your data.

auth.setupDescription: Create the local account, calculation defaults, and optional features.
auth.featuresDescription: Choose which optional modules are available. Integrations can be configured later in Settings.
auth.demoDataDescription: Creates synthetic sample data for inventory, prints, and enabled optional features.

shortcuts.title: Keyboard shortcuts
shortcuts.description: Quickly navigate and perform actions with these keyboard shortcuts.

pages.placeholder: This area is prepared for the next milestone.

settings.generalDescription: Language, appearance, date, time, and duration display for this application.
settings.calculationDescription: Currency and energy costs used for print cost calculations.
settings.printSeriesDescription: Group related print runs, repeat orders, and production targets.
settings.printSeriesDisabledHelp: Series navigation and editing are unavailable. Existing assignments remain stored and visible as text.
settings.spoolManagementDescription: Track physical spools, stock movements, QR labels, and spool-specific prices.
settings.spoolManagementDisabledHelp: Prints use filament price and net weight. Existing stock stays stored, and Spoolman is disabled.
settings.currencyHelp: The currency cannot be changed after the first cost-bearing record is created.
settings.integrationsDescription: Enable and configure optional connections. Credentials remain server-only.

backup.createDescription: Download a complete and consistent backup of all ezPrint data.
backup.sensitiveDescription: The backup contains account data, password hashes, settings, integration credentials, inventory, and prints. Store it encrypted and away from this host.
backup.restoreDescription: Replace the current data with a previously created ezPrint backup.
backup.restoreWarningDescription: The application restarts and all sessions are signed out. Backups from newer releases cannot be restored into older ezPrint versions.
backup.confirmDescription: Enter your current password to validate and restore {name}.
backup.restored: The backup was restored successfully. Sign in again.
backup.rolledBack: The backup could not be imported or migrated. The previous database was restored automatically.
backup.restartTimeout: The restart is taking longer than expected. Check the service status and container logs.
backup.restoreFailed: The backup could not be restored.

master.name: Name
master.alwaysUsedDescription: Automatically preselect for new prints with compatible printers.
master.excludeFromDashboardDescription: Hide this customer's prints from dashboard metrics, charts, and unfinished prints.
master.deleteConfirmation: This record is permanently deleted if it is not referenced.

prints.createDescription: Enter print data, durations, and materials step by step.
prints.hotendsHelp: Enter the print duration for each hotend used.
prints.previewHint: Select a printer, components, and filament to calculate a preview.
prints.statusChangeConfirmation: Leaving draft finalizes the cost snapshot and makes the print details immutable.
prints.completeConfirmation: The print is recalculated and then completed as an immutable snapshot.
prints.immutable: The print details are immutable after leaving draft. You can duplicate the print using current inventory.
prints.quantityHelp: 1–1,000,000 identical parts. Duration and material remain totals for the entire run.

dashboard.noDraftsDescription: Create a print to start calculating its cost.

outcome.title: Print outcome
outcome.pendingHelp: Confirm actual usage before recording. Corrections create a new version and retain the previous costs. Hotend time follows the proportions of the planned durations.

errors.outcomeNotAllowed: Only non-archived done prints accept outcomes.
errors.outcomeImmutable: This outcome has already been recorded and is immutable.
errors.invalidActualUsage: Enter every planned filament usage exactly once.
errors.retryNotAllowed: Only non-archived failed prints can be retried.
errors.spoolIdentityImmutable: Spool code, filament, and initial weight are immutable. Use a stock correction for balance changes.
errors.spoolArchived: Archived spools cannot receive manual stock movements.
errors.stockOperationConflict: This operation key has already been used for a different stock movement.
errors.invalidSpool: Select one active spool with remaining material for every filament line.
errors.outcomeRevisionConflict: The outcome has changed. Reload before correcting it.
errors.seriesCustomerConflict: The customer conflicts with the series. Remove series membership first.
errors.repeatNotAllowed: Only non-archived done prints can be repeated.
errors.reportNotAllowed: Only done prints have cost reports.
errors.integrationUnavailable: Remote service unavailable. Cached data is retained.
errors.integrationContract: Remote response is incompatible with the supported API.
errors.integrationConflict: Link or data changed. Refresh and resolve the conflict.
errors.integrationMetadata: Remote vendor, price and initial weight are required; archived spools cannot be imported.
errors.stockOwnedExternally: Spoolman owns this stock. Change it there or explicitly unlink first.
errors.printSeriesDisabled: Print series are disabled in Settings → Features.
errors.spoolManagementDisabled: Spool management is disabled in Settings → Features.
errors.restoreAuthorizationInvalid: The restore authorization is invalid or expired.
errors.contentLengthRequired: The backup file size could not be determined.
errors.backupTooLarge: The backup file exceeds the configured size limit.
errors.insufficientStorage: There is not enough free storage for a safe restore.
errors.backupLengthMismatch: The transferred backup file is incomplete.
errors.backupFormatUnsupported: This backup format version is not supported.
errors.backupVersionNewer: A backup from a newer ezPrint release cannot be restored.
errors.backupInvalid: The file is not a valid ezPrint backup.
errors.backupConfigInvalid: The configured backup size limit is invalid.
errors.restoreNotFound: The restore status was not found or has expired.
errors.unsupportedMediaType: Only ezPrint backup files are accepted.

validation.outcomeUniqueUsageRequired: Enter every filament usage exactly once.
validation.integrationUrl: Enter an HTTP or HTTPS URL without credentials, query parameters, or fragments.

spool.emptyDescription: Add a physical spool or adjust the search and table options.
spool.legacyHelp: Opening balance imported from the filament catalog. Verify physical weight and record a correction if needed.
spool.negative: Recorded consumption exceeds stock. Verify the balance and record a correction without deleting history.
spool.label: QR label

sales.help: Optional total for the run, in the instance currency. No invoices, taxes, or payment tracking.

series.emptyDescription: Create a print series or adjust the search and table options.
series.loadFailed: Print series could not be loaded
series.customerRule: A series customer is inherited. Remove series membership before selecting a different customer.

report.title: Cost report
report.disclaimer: Cost report only. Not an invoice or tax document.

integration.spoolmanConfigurationDescription: Configure the server connection and optional authorization header for Spoolman.
integration.spoolManagementRequired: Enable spool management under Settings → Features to configure Spoolman.
integration.bambuConfigDescription: Link printers and import completed print results.
integration.bambuConfigurationDescription: Configure the server connection and credentials for Bambuddy.
integration.credentialConfigured: Stored credential; leave empty to keep it
integration.configHelp: Connection and credentials are managed above. Stored credentials are never returned to the browser.
integration.authorityHelp: Read-only is the default. Enable consumption only if no other system deducts usage for these prints.
integration.reconcileHelp: Unknown requests may already have reached Spoolman. Check its usage history before confirming whether an operation was applied. Confirming not applied permits one new attempt.
integration.MISSING_PRICING: Vendor, price or initial weight missing
integration.requestFailed: Request failed. Check connection, permissions, data and conflicts, then refresh the preview.
integration.stale: Cached stock may be stale. Synchronize before relying on the balance.
integration.nativeBalance: Confirmed opening balance for native ownership (g)
integration.unlink: Unlink and use confirmed native balance
integration.mappingWarning: Slot mapping is ambiguous, stale or unavailable. Verify the physical spool before selecting it in a draft.
integration.resultHelp: Only terminal print-log records can supply outcomes. Review actual quantities, complete the local workflow, then confirm import. Live IDLE never completes a print.
integration.pendingResult: Outcome remains pending. Resolve cancelled or ambiguous jobs manually in the print editor.
integration.confirmResult: Confirm actual values and import outcome
